sheets.title: Exterior Elevations - Visualization R14
sheets.subtitle: Jade Estates Lot 7, South Barrington, Illinois  |  Four photoreal elevations based on exterior model R14
notes: Source: orthographic elevation exports of the SketchUp exterior model R14 (JESB_Lot7_Model_R14.skp). The geometry follows the architect's DWG elevations (xelev, 16.10.2026) and the owner's answers to RFI-001.

Method: AI image-to-image visualization of the model elevations, not a native V-Ray/Corona render. Geometry, openings, roof outlines and grade follow the model; small details are interpreted by the AI and may differ from the model (e.g. the covered terrace guardrail is white in the model).

Finishes per the ACC Material Package, Lot 7: Magnolia brick, Cobble Stone lap siding, Mission Brown shingles, white trim, fascia, soffit and windows, and brown front and garage doors. Owner selections: dark brown bronze standing-seam accent roofs, light beige cast-stone headers, and a white siding terrace deck.
Landscaping is limited to lawn and the existing hardscape. The driveway is assumed (no site plan). No trees or planting are shown.
For design review only - not for construction. Open drawing questions are listed in RFI-002.
